newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch grain harvest forecast up in 1996. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Dutch grain harvest forecast up in 1996. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: The Dutch 1996 grain crop is forecast at 1.5 million tonnes against 1.44 million in 1995 (corrects year from 1994), according to the first estimate of arable field crops, the Dutch statistical office said on Monday.
The higher grain production was attributed to a seven percent rise in yields per hectare and an extension to the growing area.
The forecast covers the production of wheat, oats, barley and rye. Record production of winter wheat made up 1.23 million tonnes of the total grain crop against 1.10 million in 1995.
